manual_fixes: District palettes were selected editorially from local or regional character references; these colors are not a surveyed facade inventory.
Separated mainland Cocoa (new cocoa-village ID) from the existing cocoa ID, which remains Cocoa Beach; corrected the beach city price source.
Added six missing cities and coastal communities. Residential styles use the approved low-house recipe; explicit commercial and apartment tags retain their height handling.
Curated hero points at mapped parks, piers, historic streets and harbor entrances; West Melbourne retains its inland town anchor.
Added a small live OSM patch for the real VAB building and roads, with OSM height and NASA reference; no fabricated landmark position or footprint.
Public sightseeing/fishing piers are exported as decks without moored boats.
Extended measured WorldCover canopy to five hero frames outside the district-label raster windows.
Extended Cocoa Beach’s source envelope and fetched actual OSM footprints around the pier, beyond the original seed box.
Cocoa Village displays the City of Cocoa market scope explicitly on its card, rather than claiming a neighborhood-specific median.
